root.label: Christopher Pelkey fatally shot in Chandler road rage encounter

events.label: Christopher Pelkey fatally shot in Chandler road rage encounter

slots.name: date of incident
slots.sentence: Authorities say Horcasitas, 55, fatally shot Pelkey, 37, during a November 2021 road rage encounter at a stoplight in Chandler, a suburb of Phoenix.

slots.name: conviction status
slots.sentence: Horcasitas was convicted of manslaughter in Pelkey’s death and endangerment for a gunshot that struck another vehicle at the intersection during the encounter.
